original_assumption: Treat 6 vs 8 as a count discrepancy.
failure_reason: Official pages use center, location, presence, terminal, office and outreach with different dates.
revised_approach: Use a dated typed hierarchy: 2021 seven listed locations; 2025 six centers; current eight typed presences.
effect_on_numbers: No single site count is discarded; three vocabularies remain.
effect_on_claims: Count changes no longer imply openings/closures.

original_assumption: Treat USD 41.212m as an unexplained duplicate/conflict field.
failure_reason: The funding endpoints show it is the account-linked rollup of 24m - 6.7875m + 24m, while transaction history includes an additional 2025 24m.
revised_approach: Preserve USD 72m award-level and USD 41.212m account-linked figures side by side; record reporting/timing conflict.
effect_on_numbers: The 41.212 figure is now decomposed but not reconciled to 72m.
effect_on_claims: It is not a second award or local share.
principal_decision_requirement: Approve wording and whether later File C recheck is needed.

original_assumption: Use the current sponsor roster as the local funding picture.
failure_reason: Current tiers omit amounts; official dated stories expose some cash and in-kind actions across years.
revised_approach: Keep roster relations and dated resource flows in separate rows; never total mixed years/currencies.
effect_on_numbers: Exact flows increase, but no Okinawa budget is calculated.
effect_on_claims: Local sponsor visibility is demonstrated as bounded episodes.
principal_decision_requirement: Decide which rows merit later resource-ledger promotion.

original_assumption: Use all USO counts as service volume.
failure_reason: Uses, visits, people reached, supported population, volunteers and selected-event participants are different units.
revised_approach: Keep every metric typed and prohibit conversion across definitions.
effect_on_claims: Capacity can be described without a fabricated denominator.
principal_decision_requirement: No additional decision unless a local annual metric appears.

original_assumption: Describe USO, Red Cross and NMCRS as parallel generic welfare services.
failure_reason: Official pages reveal distinct cores and one specific Red Cross-NMCRS after-hours handoff using NMCRS funds.
revised_approach: Build a function matrix and type the handoff as service intermediation, not funding/alliance.
effect_on_numbers: One confirmed intra-service-ecology handoff is added to the research package.
effect_on_claims: The three organizations are complementary/overlapping in typed functions, not interchangeable.
principal_decision_requirement: Confirm relation semantics before any central proposal.

original_assumption: Draw a single numeric national-to-local waterfall.
failure_reason: There is no region allocation, local observations mix dates/currencies, and national expense/award/account fields have different perimeters.
revised_approach: Draw an allocation-visibility waterfall with separate national, local-input and non-money lanes.
effect_on_numbers: No synthetic Okinawa amount is generated.
effect_on_claims: The missing allocation layer becomes the visual finding.
